2607.02069.title: Algebraic Model Counting for Global Analysis of Optimal Decision Trees
2607.02069.paper_summary: Ensuring model reliability in Explainable AI requires a global assessment of the hypothesis space. We propose a formal framework for the exhaustive analysis of optimal and near-optimal decision trees, called Algebraic Decision Tree Counting (ADTC). Inspired by Algebraic Model Counting (AMC) in knowledge representation, ADTC reformulates diverse analytical tasks, such as optimization, counting, and sampling, into a unified sum-of-products computation over a semiring $R$. While the hypothesis space of decision trees is doubly exponential with respect to the maximum depth $Δ$, our dynamic programming algorithm achieves $O^*(n^{O(Δ)})$ time complexity in the number of features $n$, where $O^*$ suppresses polynomial factors. To handle complex constraints consisting of multiple tree metrics, we introduce model behavior tensors that aggregate semiring values via convolution products over a tensor semiring. This algebraic approach efficiently constructs a model profile that captures the global landscape and trade-offs between criteria such as accuracy, size, and fairness. We demonstrate the utility of our software, emtrees, on real-world datasets, illustrating how ADTC facilitates evidence-based model selection in sensitive domains.
2607.02069.paper_summary_zh: 確保可解釋人工智慧中的模型可靠性需要對假設空間進行全局評估。<lb/>我們提出了一個正式框架，用於對最佳和近最佳決策樹進行徹底分析，稱為代數決策樹計數 (ADTC)。<lb/>受到知識表示中代數模型計數 (AMC) 的啟發，ADTC 將優化、計數和抽樣等多樣的分析任務重新表述為在半環 $R$ 上的統一乘和計算。<lb/>雖然決策樹的假設空間相對於最大深度 $Δ$ 是雙指數級的，但我們的動態規劃算法在特徵數量 $n$ 上達到了 $O^*(n^{O(Δ)})$ 的時間複雜度，其中 $O^*$ 壓制了多項式因子。<lb/>為了處理由多個樹指標組成的複雜約束，我們引入了模型行為張量，通過在張量半環上進行卷積乘積來聚合半環值。<lb/>這種代數方法有效地構建了一個模型配置文件，捕捉了全球範圍和準確性、大小及公平性等標準之間的權衡。<lb/>我們展示了我們的軟體 emtrees 在現實世界數據集上的效用，說明 ADTC 如何促進在敏感領域中的基於證據的模型選擇。
